title: Amphiphilic carbonaceous materials: preparation methods and applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17049-17079
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01447F, Review Article

Ming-ming Chen, Cheng-yang Wang, Masahiro Toyoda, Michio Inagaki
Amphiphilic carbonaceous materials (ACMs) refer to a class of materials rich in sp2 C domains and are composed of hydrophilic functional groups with hydrophobic conjugated aromatic domains. Herein, their applications were reviewed.
